intent: Stable shader/resource metadata for Lucerna-owned Vulkan passes. This file is descriptive until the native renderer consumes it.
subAgentRule: Do not run shader compilation, Gradle checks, Minecraft launches, render smoke tests, or builds used as verification.

naming.passNameFormat: lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores; keep existing public ids stable
naming.descriptorNameFormat: UpperCamelCase logical resource names with fixed set/binding numbers

phase5Telemetry.intent: Canonical Phase 5 names and order for direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, and ray-budget debug targets.

readyWhen: G-buffer attachment names and formats are bound
Frame constants provide sun, moon, time, weather, and viewport data
EmissiveBlockList generation matches the uploaded world/material generation
Shadow candidate budget and direct-light validation flags are supplied through push constants
stageReadiness.openUntil: A non-placeholder direct-light shader writes visible sun, moon, emissive, and shadow-ray results into lucerna.lighting.direct.

readyWhen: lucerna.lighting.direct is available for bounce input
VoxelOccupancy and DirtyRegionQueue generations are coherent
RadianceHistory and VarianceConfidence are valid or explicitly reset
Cache confidence, variance, and ray-budget attachments are allocated at half resolution
stageReadiness.openUntil: A non-placeholder GI shader writes low-resolution diffuse radiance, confidence, variance, ray-budget classification, and temporal history updates.

readyWhen: Direct lighting and diffuse GI outputs are readable
PreviousDepth, PreviousNormalRoughness, PreviousLighting, MotionHistory, and VarianceConfidence are valid or reset
Cache confidence and variance ranges are documented for clamp/rejection decisions
stageReadiness.openUntil: A non-placeholder denoise shader writes full-resolution lucerna.denoise.diffuse and lucerna.denoise.rejectionMask.

readyWhen: Denoised diffuse lighting is available at full resolution
Optional debug overlay target is readable when overlay mode is active
Borrowed Minecraft/Sodium world color target remains owned by the frame hook
stageReadiness.openUntil: A non-placeholder composite path combines lighting with albedo and writes only lucerna.composite.worldColor before HUD and late translucency.

firstLightingMilestone.goal: Visible basic emissive/direct light plus direct-light resolve through final composite, under controller-run screenshot and log validation.
entryBoundary: Lucerna is active only on Sodium Vulkan
World/material upload generations have reached native queues
G-buffer targets are allocated and contain current-frame world data
No-op or flat composite path remains validated as non-corrupting
inScope: Voxel shadow-ray visibility for direct lighting
Cache confidence, variance, and ray-budget metadata
Composite into the borrowed world color target before HUD and late translucency
Debug labels that expose stage readiness and milestone boundary state
outOfScope: Swapchain ownership or a separate render loop
Hardware ray tracing for entities or complex models
Volumetrics, water/transparency handling, temporal upscaling, and ReSTIR reservoirs
exitBoundary: Controller observes non-placeholder direct lighting in lucerna.lighting.direct
Controller observes a direct-light resolve into lucerna.composite.worldColor without consuming Iris shader-pack outputs
Controller observes the disabled or baseline screenshot return to vanilla/no-op behavior
Controller observes debug overlay telemetry for candidate counts, dispatch frame, output-buffer status, and no HUD corruption
Stage readiness debug labels distinguish contract-ready stages from algorithm-complete stages
controllerScreenshotMarkers: baseline_disabled_or_noop: Lucerna disabled or no-op path shows the same test wall without direct-light contribution
enabled_direct: Lucerna enabled shows nearby surfaces brightened by one emissive block, sun, or moon input
debug_overlay_direct: overlay text or heatmap shows direct lighting enabled, emissive candidate count, shadow candidate count, dispatch frame, and output/resolve status
hud_integrity: crosshair, hotbar, chat, and debug text remain readable and are not tinted or overwritten
iris_isolation: Iris may expose Lucerna status/settings, but no Iris shader-pack color, depth, or lighting output is sampled by this pass

phase5Telemetry.placeholderPolicy: All noop.glsl files must remain side-effect free and document future reads/writes without declaring storage images, atomics, barriers, discard, color output, or depth output.

phase5Payloads.intent: Descriptive payload contracts for the first lighting milestone. These entries do not add descriptor bindings or require shader algorithm implementation.

descriptorInputs.name: LucernaFrameConstants
descriptorInputs.payload: camera, viewport, time, weather, dimension hash, active pass mask, and debug validation flags

descriptorInputs.name: BlueNoiseTexture
descriptorInputs.payload: frame-indexed sampling offset for direct shadow rays and emissive sampling

descriptorInputs.name: MaterialTable
descriptorInputs.payload: material opacity, emissive strength, and surface flags used by direct shadow rays

descriptorInputs.name: VoxelOccupancy
descriptorInputs.payload: voxel visibility data for direct shadow-ray traversal

descriptorInputs.name: EmissiveBlockList
descriptorInputs.payload: bounded world-space emissive candidates with generation tracking from native upload

attachmentPayload.channels: rgb direct radiance in linear scene space; alpha reserved for direct visibility or confidence

round5ResolveContract.baselineMode: Lucerna disabled or direct-light resolve disabled must leave the borrowed world color target visually equivalent to the validated no-op or flat-composite path.
round5ResolveContract.enabledMode: Direct-light resolve samples lucerna.lighting.direct and current albedo/opacity to make one nearby surface visibly brighter when a bounded emissive, sun, or moon candidate is present.
outputMarkers: native direct lighting dispatch logged for the current frame
emissive candidate count is greater than zero when a glowstone, lamp, lava, or torch candidate is near the viewed wall
direct output buffer write marker is present before resolve
direct resolve marker is present before vanilla HUD and late translucency
round5ResolveContract.irisIsolation: The direct-light resolve must not read or derive color from Iris shader-pack outputs; Iris remains settings/status-visible only while Lucerna owns rendering.

handoffRules: Do not write GI, denoise, or debug targets.
Downstream GI may sample this as first-bounce input after compute_write_to_shader_read transition.

descriptorInputs.name: VoxelOccupancy
descriptorInputs.payload: visibility and occupancy for low-resolution diffuse bounce tracing

descriptorInputs.name: DirtyRegionQueue
descriptorInputs.payload: dirty-region generation used to invalidate cache records near changed blocks, fluids, chunks, and materials

descriptorInputs.name: RadianceHistory
descriptorInputs.payload: temporal diffuse GI radiance cache, invalidated on resize, dimension switch, resource reload, or history reset

descriptorInputs.name: VarianceConfidence
descriptorInputs.payload: temporal variance and confidence cache, paired with current-frame confidence and variance outputs

outputs.channels: rgb single-bounce diffuse radiance; alpha reserved for history weight or validity
x current confidence; y cache age or invalidation reason

cacheRecordRules: A dirty-region generation mismatch forces confidence toward zero before denoise consumes the payload.
History reset on dimension switch, world leave, resource reload, or resize must reset RadianceHistory and VarianceConfidence.
The first lighting milestone needs current-frame confidence and variance even if richer adaptive sampling remains future work.

denoiseOutputs.channels: rgb full-resolution diffuse lighting; alpha reserved for resolved confidence
x temporal rejection, reactive, or history repair mask

resolveRules: Resolve happens before vanilla HUD and late translucency.
Resolve must preserve Minecraft/Sodium ownership of the world color target.
Resolve must be disableable so controller screenshots can compare baseline and enabled frames from the same scene.
Resolve must not consume Iris shader-pack color, depth, shadow, or lighting textures.

handoffBoundary: Denoise owns upsampling and history rejection before composite.
Composite owns final world color staging only and must preserve Minecraft/Sodium swapchain ownership.
Composite runs before vanilla HUD and late translucency; it must not consume Iris shader-pack outputs.

round5OverlayInputs: CPU/native/GPU timing placeholder or timing value when available
displayRules: Readiness labels report contract-ready versus algorithm-complete state.
Milestone boundary labels must remain visible through debug overlay metadata even before real lighting shaders land.
Round 5 overlay text must identify whether visible direct output is still pending controller validation.
Overlay inputs are Lucerna-owned telemetry; they do not sample Iris shader-pack outputs.
Labels are descriptive until the debug telemetry worker backs DebugLabelTable with runtime data.

fields.name: view
fields.description: Current world-to-view matrix.

fields.name: projection
fields.description: Current projection matrix after Minecraft/Sodium viewport selection.

fields.name: viewProjection
fields.description: Current projection * view matrix.

fields.name: previousViewProjection
fields.description: Previous accepted frame matrix, invalidated on dimension switch, resource reload, or history reset.

fields.name: inverseViewProjection
fields.description: Inverse of current viewProjection for ray reconstruction.

fields.name: cameraWorldPosition
fields.description: xyz camera origin in world coordinates, w reserved.

fields.name: viewport
fields.description: x, y, width, height in framebuffer pixels.

fields.name: renderScale
fields.description: full-resolution scale, GI scale, denoise scale, reserved.

fields.name: clipPlanes
fields.description: near, far, reversedZ flag, reserved.

fields.name: frameInfo
fields.description: frameIndex, historyIndex, dimensionHash, qualityPreset.

fields.name: worldInfo
fields.description: timeOfDay, rainStrength, thunderStrength, skyDarken.

fields.name: debugInfo
fields.description: debugOverlayMode, validationFlags, activePassMask, reserved.

fields.name: passId
fields.description: Stable numeric id mapped from the pass id string by the native renderer.

fields.name: passFlags
fields.description: Per-pass feature toggles and validation flags.

fields.name: frameIndex
fields.description: Mirrors frame constants for lightweight dispatch-only passes.

fields.name: debugMode
fields.description: Selected overlay or pass debug mode.

fields.name: targetSize
fields.description: Dispatch or render target dimensions in pixels.

fields.name: sourceSize
fields.description: Primary input dimensions in pixels.

fields.name: params0
fields.description: Pass-owned scalar values such as kernel radius, exposure, blend factor, or ray budget.

fields.name: params1
fields.description: Pass-owned scalar values for future expansion.

perPassUse.params0: dirty region generation, voxel update count, upload batch id, reserved
section generation, material generation, render flags, reserved
sun strength, moon strength, shadow ray budget, reserved
perPassUse.params1: emissive list generation, blue-noise frame offset, direct-light validation flags, reserved

perPassUse.params0: GI resolution scale, bounce count, cache confidence threshold, adaptive ray budget
perPassUse.params1: variance target, adaptive sample floor, adaptive sample ceiling, history reset weight

perPassUse.params0: kernel radius, history blend, variance clamp, rejection strength
perPassUse.params1: cache confidence weight, variance floor, variance ceiling, reactive mask threshold

perPassUse.params0: overlay mode, selected material id, min value, max value
perPassUse.params1: debug label table offset, ray budget display scale, cache confidence display scale, variance display scale

perPassUse.params0: flat red, flat green, flat blue, flat alpha
perPassUse.params1: debug overlay blend, exposure, tonemap flags, borrowed target flags

descriptorSets.name: frame
descriptorSets.scope: per-frame global constants and immutable samplers

bindings.name: LucernaCameraHistory
bindings.notes: Previous camera jitter, accepted history age, and history reset reason.

descriptorSets.name: world
descriptorSets.scope: material, chunk, voxel, and world-delta resources owned by world/material/upload agents

bindings.name: VoxelOccupancy
bindings.notes: Updated by lucerna.voxel.first_pass and read by lucerna.gbuffer.main plus lighting passes.

bindings.name: WorldUploadScratch
bindings.notes: Reserved for GPU-side upload staging once native upload packets exist.

bindings.name: RadianceHistory
bindings.notes: Temporal diffuse GI radiance accumulation written and read by lucerna.lighting.gi; denoise consumes the resolved lighting outputs instead.

bindings.name: VarianceConfidence
bindings.notes: Temporal aggregate for diffuse GI variance and cache confidence. Current-frame variance/cache confidence attachments are written by lucerna.lighting.gi before this history image is updated.

descriptorSets.name: debug
descriptorSets.scope: debug overlays, timing readback, and native queue telemetry

bindings.name: DebugLabelTable
bindings.notes: Stable debug labels for pass ids, attachment names, cache confidence, variance, and adaptive sampling overlays.

attachments.name: lucerna.gbuffer.depth
fallbackFormats: D24_UNORM_S8_UINT when a borrowed Minecraft/Sodium depth target requires stencil compatibility

attachments.name: lucerna.lighting.direct
attachments.notes: Full-resolution storage write for sun, moon, emissive block sampling, and direct shadow ray output. Clear before write; never blend with borrowed Minecraft color targets.

attachments.name: lucerna.lighting.diffuseGi
attachments.notes: Half-resolution single-bounce diffuse GI radiance. Denoise owns upsampling and history rejection before final composite.

attachments.name: lucerna.lighting.cacheConfidence
attachments.notes: Half-resolution current-frame cache confidence. Channel x is confidence, y is reserved for cache age or invalidation reason.

attachments.name: lucerna.lighting.variance
attachments.notes: Half-resolution current-frame diffuse GI variance used for denoise clamps, history rejection, and debug visualization.

attachments.name: lucerna.lighting.rayBudget
attachments.notes: Reserved ray-budget debug target and adaptive sampling classification for GI pixels or tiles: 0 reuse-only, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high.

attachments.name: lucerna.denoise.diffuse
attachments.notes: Full-resolution denoised diffuse lighting. This is the composite input after cache-confidence weighting, variance clamp, and history rejection.

attachments.name: lucerna.denoise.rejectionMask
attachments.notes: Full-resolution mask for temporal rejection, reactive pixels, and history repair diagnostics.

attachments.name: lucerna.composite.worldColor
attachments.format: borrowed Minecraft/Sodium world color target format
consumers: Minecraft HUD and late translucency after Lucerna completes
attachments.notes: Lucerna must not own swapchain presentation; the frame hook borrows the active world color target.

attachments.name: lucerna.debug.overlay
attachments.notes: Optional full-resolution debug overlay composed by lucerna.composite.final when debug overlay mode is active.

passes.handoff: Stages dirty voxel occupancy metadata consumed by the main G-buffer pass; placeholder remains side-effect free until native upload work lands.
Provides full-resolution geometry/material buffers for lighting, denoise, flat composite, and debug workers.
Direct sun, moon, and emissive block lighting target for Round 5 direct-light resolve.

attachmentWriteSemantics.notes: Writes full-resolution direct sun, moon, emissive, and shadow-ray lighting into a Lucerna-owned storage image. Round 5 composite resolve may sample this target to produce controller-visible lighting before HUD and late translucency.

passes.handoff: Low-resolution first-bounce diffuse GI, cache confidence, variance, and ray-budget debug/adaptive sampling output.

attachmentWriteSemantics.notes: Writes half-resolution diffuse GI radiance before denoise upsampling and composite.
Writes current-frame cache confidence used by denoise, debug overlays, and temporal confidence history.
Writes current-frame diffuse GI variance before denoise clamps and history rejection.
Reserves ray-budget debug target and adaptive sampling classification output for future cache/adaptive sampling work; placeholder remains side-effect free.

passes.handoff: Edge-aware diffuse denoise, temporal rejection mask, and history repair input.

attachmentWriteSemantics.notes: Writes full-resolution diffuse lighting after cache-confidence weighting, variance clamp, and temporal rejection.
Writes an 8-bit rejection/reactive mask for debug overlays and later history repair.

passes.handoff: Backend, dirty-region, material-id, timing, native queue, direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, ray-budget, and debug label overlays.

attachmentWriteSemantics.notes: Writes optional debug visualization for backend status, dirty regions, material ids, timings, native queues, direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, and ray budget.

passes.handoff: Flat composite staging output into the borrowed world color target before vanilla HUD and late translucency.

attachmentWriteSemantics.notes: Matches LucernaFramePassKind.FLAT_COMPOSITE staging, writes only the borrowed Minecraft/Sodium world color target, and preserves swapchain ownership.

validationScenarios.description: Parse layout.json and verify unique pass ids, numeric ids, descriptor set/binding pairs, and attachment names.
Verify dependsOn edges point at declared earlier passes and that attachmentWriteSemantics reference attachments written by their owning pass.
Verify direct lighting, GI, denoise, debug, and composite passes declare attachmentWriteSemantics for every Lucerna-owned attachment they write.
Confirm cache confidence, current-frame variance, adaptive ray budget, RadianceHistory, and VarianceConfidence are produced before denoise and debug overlays consume them.
Confirm phase5Telemetry.debugTargetNames mirrors declared attachments and debugLabels for direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, and ray budget.
Confirm phase5Payloads references only declared pass ids, descriptor set/binding pairs, attachments, and history resources while preserving existing numeric ids.
Confirm the first lighting milestone entry and exit boundaries cover direct lighting, GI/cache, denoise, composite, and debug-readiness handoff states.
Confirm lucerna.gbuffer.main attachment names match GBufferTargetContract depth, normalRoughness, albedoOpacity, materialId, emissive, and motionHistory.
Confirm placeholder shaders do not declare storage writes, image writes, atomics, barriers, discard, or fixed color/depth outputs.
When Lucerna is active on Sodium Vulkan, execute future no-op passes in executionOrder without altering HUD, late translucency, or swapchain ownership.
Confirm the flat composite staging pass writes only the borrowed world color target and keeps swapchain ownership with Minecraft/Sodium.
Confirm DebugLabelTable contains stable labels for pass ids, attachment names, direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, and ray-budget overlay modes.
Confirm DebugLabelTable can expose readiness.lucerna.* stage labels and milestone.round4.first_lighting.* boundary labels before real lighting shaders replace placeholders.

Capture baseline/disabled, enabled direct-light, and direct debug-overlay screenshots for one emissive block lighting one visible surface; confirm HUD readability and matching native dispatch/output/resolve log markers.

Confirm the Round 5 direct-light output and resolve path consumes Lucerna-owned G-buffer/direct-light/debug resources only and does not sample Iris shader-pack color, depth, shadow, or lighting outputs.
Confirm lucerna.lighting.rayBudget uses the documented 0 reuse-only, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high classification before cache/adaptive sampling work consumes it.
On no-Sodium, OpenGL-forced, or Vulkan-unavailable launches, Lucerna should not allocate or bind resources from this layout.
Resize full-resolution and half-resolution attachments from the active viewport, refresh debug overlay target, and preserve stable pass ids.
Resource-pack reload refreshes material, blue-noise, and debug label resources while invalidating temporal history.
Dimension switch, world leave, or world join clears PreviousDepth, PreviousLighting, RadianceHistory, VarianceConfidence, and MotionHistory consumers.
Chunk stream and block/material updates advance generation counters before lighting and debug passes consume DirtyRegionQueue.

Debug overlay modes can sample backend status, dirty regions, material ids, timing readback, native queue telemetry, direct lighting, diffuse GI, denoise, composite, cache confidence, variance, ray budget, and debug labels without requiring Iris shader-pack rendering.
